12-biomarker_concordance_plot



library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)






# 12.1 Import Data


data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
raw_data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/raw_data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"

metadata_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"), 
  stringsAsFactors=F)

# Protein matrix
protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path("C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data/protein_mat.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F, check.names=F)

# Gene matrix
full_vsd <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "vst_full.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F, check.names=F)

full_vsd <- full_vsd %>%
 { colnames(.)[1] <- "gene"; . }

# Map ENSG to gene symbols
ensg2gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F) %>%
  { `names<-`(.$gene_symbol, .$X) }

full_vsd <- full_vsd %>%
  mutate(
    gene_symbol = ensg2gene[gene],
    gene_symbol = ifelse(is.na(gene_symbol), gene, gene_symbol))






# 12.2 Prepare RNA/Protein concordance for selected genes


genes_to_plot <- c("FABP4", "ISG15", "IFIT2", "IFIT3", "APOE", "SLAMF7", "OLAH")

for (selected_gene in genes_to_plot) {

  # RNA: select and scale
  rna_gene_long <- full_vsd %>%
    filter(gene_symbol == selected_gene) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(gene, gene_symbol),
      names_to = "sample_name",
      values_to = "expr"
    ) %>%
    mutate(expr_scaled_rna = as.numeric(scale(expr)))

  # Protein: select and scale
  protein_gene_long <- protein_mat %>%
    { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id, all_of(selected_gene)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -patient_id,
      names_to = "gene_symbol",
      values_to = "expr"
    ) %>%
    mutate(expr_scaled_protein = as.numeric(scale(expr))) 

  # Merge RNA & protein via metadata
  gene_concordance <- metadata_df %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
    left_join(rna_gene_long, by = "sample_name") %>%
    left_join(protein_gene_long, by = c("patient_id", "gene_symbol"))






# 12.3 Scatter plot RNA vs Protein for selected gene

  # Pearson
  pearson_res <- cor.test(
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna,
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein,
    method = "pearson"
  )

  pearson_r <- round(pearson_res$estimate, 2)
  pearson_p   <- signif(pearson_res$p.value, 2)

  p <- ggplot(gene_concordance, aes(
    x = expr_scaled_rna, y = expr_scaled_protein)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, color = "#4C72B0") +
    geom_smooth(method="lm", se=TRUE,
            color="grey30", fill="grey70", alpha=0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    labs(
      title = paste(selected_gene, "RNA/Protein Concordance"),
      subtitle = "Each point = one patient (n=105)",
      x = "RNA expression (z-score)",
      y = "Protein expression (z-score)"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = max(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna, na.rm=T) + 0.25,
      y = max(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein, na.rm=T),
      label = paste0("r = ", pearson_r, "\np = ", pearson_p),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 3.5,
      lineheight = 1.2
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
      plot.margin  = ggplot2::margin(t=10, r=110, b=10, l=10)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(min(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna, na.rm=T) - 0.2,
               max(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna, na.rm=T) + 0.2),
      ylim = c(min(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein, na.rm=T) - 0.2,
               max(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein, na.rm=T) + 0.2),
      clip = "off"
    )

  print(p)

   ggsave(
    file.path(results_dir, paste0(selected_gene, "_RNA_vs_Protein_concordance.pdf")),
    plot        = p,
    width       = 7,
    height      = 5,
    device      = "pdf",
    useDingbats = FALSE
  )

}








# 12.4 Scatter plot RNA vs Protein by adjudication


for (selected_gene in genes_to_plot) {

  # RNA
  rna_gene_long <- full_vsd %>%
    filter(gene_symbol == selected_gene) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(gene, gene_symbol),
      names_to = "sample_name",
      values_to = "expr"
    ) %>%
    mutate(expr_scaled_rna = as.numeric(scale(expr)))

  # Protein
  protein_gene_long <- protein_mat %>%
    { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
    dplyr::select(patient_id, all_of(selected_gene)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -patient_id,
      names_to = "gene_symbol",
      values_to = "expr"
    ) %>%
    mutate(expr_scaled_protein = as.numeric(scale(expr))) 
  
  # Merge
  gene_concordance <- metadata_df %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
    left_join(rna_gene_long, by = "sample_name") %>%
    left_join(protein_gene_long, by = c("patient_id", "gene_symbol"))






# 12.5 Scatter plot colored by adjudication


  # Spearman per group
  pearson_definite <- cor.test(
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna[gene_concordance$LRTI_adjudication == "Definite"],
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein[gene_concordance$LRTI_adjudication == "Definite"],
    method = "pearson"
  )

  pearson_noevidence <- cor.test(
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna[gene_concordance$LRTI_adjudication == "No Evidence"],
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein[gene_concordance$LRTI_adjudication == "No Evidence"],
    method = "pearson"
  )
  
  r_definite   <- round(pearson_definite$estimate, 2)
  r_noevidence <- round(pearson_noevidence$estimate, 2)
  
  # BH correction across the 2 group-wise tests
  p_vals_adj <- p.adjust(
    c(pearson_definite$p.value, pearson_noevidence$p.value),
    method = "BH"
  )
  padj_definite   <- signif(p_vals_adj[1], 2)
  padj_noevidence <- signif(p_vals_adj[2], 2)
  

  # p value 
  interaction_p <- summary(lm(
    expr_scaled_protein ~ expr_scaled_rna * as.character(LRTI_adjudication),
    data = gene_concordance))$coefficients["expr_scaled_rna:as.character(LRTI_adjudication)No Evidence", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  
  label_text <- paste0(
    "Definite: r = ", r_definite, ", Padj = ", padj_definite, "\n",
    "No Evidence: r = ", r_noevidence, ", Padj = ", padj_noevidence, "\n",
    "Interaction p = ", signif(interaction_p, 2)
  )

  p <- ggplot(gene_concordance,aes(
    x = expr_scaled_rna, y = expr_scaled_protein, color = LRTI_adjudication)
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Definite" = "red",
      "No Evidence" = "#0072B2"
    )) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    labs(
      title = paste(selected_gene, "RNA/Protein Concordance"),
      subtitle = "Colored by LRTI adjudication (72 Definite, 33 No Evidence)",
      x = "RNA expression (z-score)",
      y = "Protein expression (z-score)",
      color = "LRTI adjudication"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = max(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna, na.rm=TRUE) + 0.25,
      y = max(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein, na.rm=TRUE),
      label = label_text,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 3,
      lineheight = 1.2
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.margin  = ggplot2::margin(t=10, r=150, b=10, l=10)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(min(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.2,
               max(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.2),
      ylim = c(min(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.2,
               max(gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.2),
      clip = "off"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(results_dir,
    paste0(selected_gene,"_RNA_vs_Protein_concordance_by_adjudication.pdf")),
    plot        = p,
    width       = 7,
    height      = 5,
    device      = "pdf",
    useDingbats = FALSE
  )

}
